surface: Release note fragment schema, render_release_notes.py, render_release_migrations.py, .agentic/releases/README.md
summary: Adds first-class migration_guidance field to release-note fragments for unambiguous upgrade recipes.
migration_impact: Fragment schema gains an optional migration_guidance field (string or ordered-steps array). Renderers now display a prominent 'Migration steps' section when the field is present.
migration_guidance: 1. Add 'migration_guidance' (string or array of strings) to any new release-note fragment where upgrade steps are discrete.
2. Pull updated scripts/render_release_notes.py and scripts/render_release_migrations.py — both now render the field.
3. Update .agentic/releases/README.md to the new version that documents both fields and both layouts.
4. Existing fragments without the field continue to render correctly (field is optional).
agent_notes: Prefer migration_guidance (array) for step-by-step recipes, and keep migration_impact as the prose summary. Both can coexist. Renderers surface migration_guidance as a numbered/bulleted 'Migration steps' block.
